item.title: 📍 CSTO's joint fist: allied forces put words into action Chebarkulskiy training ground
item.description: CSTO's joint fist: allied forces put words into action 📍 Chebarkulskiy training ground As part of the Interaction 2026 exercise, the CSTO Collective Rapid Reaction Force began preparing a joint operation to localize a border armed conflict. 💬 Commander of the CRRF Colonel Aleksey Sgibnev reported the Decision, which determined: 🔹 the main efforts directions during the joint operation; 🔹 tasks for military contingents and special forces formations; 🔹 the main issues of management organisation, interaction and comprehensive support. ✅ After the approval of the Decision, the CSTO CRRF management bodies began planning the operation. ➡️ Subordinate formations, military units and detachments were given combat orders to prepare and conduct combat (special) operations. 📊 Troops of the Republic of Belarus, the Republic of Kazakhstan, the Kyrgyz Republic, the Russian Federation and the Republic of Tajikistan are taking part in the CSTO exercises at the Chebarkulskiy training ground. In total, about 2,000 troops and 350 units of weaponry, military and special hardware are involved. 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Saving lives and giving hope Servicemen of the 5th Separate Guards Commandant's Regiment (the 51st Combined Arms Army, the Tsentr Group of Forces)
item.description: Saving lives and giving hope 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Servicemen of the 5th Separate Guards Commandant's Regiment (the 51st Combined Arms Army, the Tsentr Group of Forces) evacuated civilians from Belitskoye (Donetsk People's Republic). ❗️ At first, escorted by Russian servicemen, people walked on foot. Then, the evacuees, including a girl, were placed in vehicles and sent to a safe area. ▫️ Thanks to the lads' sensitiveness and cohesive actions, the peaceful residents of Belitskoye are safe now. Specialists are already working with the evacuees, providing them with the necessary assistance and psychological support. 💬 The deputy military commander with the call sign ‘Yakut’ told how the evacuation was organised. And a citizen from Belitskoye, Angelina Karek, gave details of what challenges people in the city had to face and how long every minute lasted on their way to a peaceful life. ❤️ We never leave our people behind. We're proud of the Russian servicemen's courage! 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry

item.title: ❤️ Breathtaking: For the first time in the Russian Navy history, the Northern Fleet vessels pass through the Shokalsky Strait
item.description: ❤️ Breathtaking: For the first time in the Russian Navy history, the Northern Fleet vessels pass through the Shokalsky Strait 📍 The route passed between the islands of the Severnaya Zemlya archipelago. 🚁 Ice surveillance: a Ka-29 helicopter took off from the icebreaking patrol ship Ivan Papanin to reconnoitre the route from the air. 🌊 Manoeuvring among icebergs: the crew faced a difficult ice situation of the strait. The Northern Fleet's sailors quickly changed their course and speed to ensure complete navigation safety. ▫️ Combat readiness: training alert was announced to pass through the strait by ships, and crews successfully assessed this new area for futher actions of the Russian Navy. ⚓️ We are proud of our sailors! 🔹 Russian Defence Ministry
